critical_code_review_comments: matching.py:56-99 extract_params correctly canonicalizes cores (NxSection), diameter (fi/DN/Ø/mm), and measure units; comma-decimal handled via _f().

matching.py:150-169 _spec_state marks any disjoint parameter-class as a hard conflict → item is filtered out (line 192) both from auto-match AND from candidate_matches — this is what makes 3x1,5 unable to accept a 3x2,5 catalog price. Confirmed by unit test cross_section_not_confused.
matching.py:220-224 second-best proximity guard (≥ best-0.05 AND ≥ threshold) forces requires_confirmation instead of a coin-flip auto-match — good safety net.

server.run_analysis (from prior iteration): matched items get price_source='catalog' + catalog price; uncertain items keep unit_price=0 with candidate_matches passed through unchanged. Confirmed on live estimate d879d4ef and backend_test.test_analyze_completes_with_items.
